user.description: an instance of an application-level Java class that wraps the Java Subject, for instance, Hadoop's UserGroupInformation

javaSubject.description: the internal Java Subject instance; this may not be available through the JaasSubject

tickets.description: details about tickets(kerberos, for instance) that are associated with the JassSubject

title:
SaslSubject implementation. An object of this type represents a java security Subject active in the system.
A SaslSubject can be instantiated through JAAS configuration or programmatically. In any case, for a JAAS subject,
there will be a javax.security.auth.Subject internally.

A KerberosSpec is used in materializing a SaslSubject when Kerberos is used for its SASL mechanism.
name: SaslSubject
